FAQs
items.html:
What is a tongue scraper??
A tongue scraper is a tool designed to clean the surface of the tongue by removing debris and bacteria.
How does a tongue cleaner work?
A tongue cleaner (also known as a tongue scrubber, tongue scraper, or tongue brush) typically has a curved or flat edge that is gently dragged across the tongue's surface to collect and remove accumulated debris and bacteria.
Why should I use a tongue scraper?
Tongue scraping helps improve oral hygiene by reducing bacteria on the tongue, fighting bad breath, and promoting overall oral health.
Do tongue brushes help with bad breath?
Regular use of a tongue brush in oral care can significantly reduce the chances of bad breath by removing the bacteria that contribute to halitosis.
What makes SuperMouth’s tongue scrapers superior?
SuperMouth’s tongue scrapers are distinct due to their innovative, patented design. Each scraper features a dual-sided approach: one side is equipped with a brush to gently but effectively loosen microbes from the tongue’s surface, which differs significantly from tooth enamel. The other side incorporates a scraper to efficiently remove these loosened microbes. This unique combination ensures that our tongue scrapers are exceptionally effective in maintaining oral hygiene.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html: Stick your tongue out and brush all the surfaces Start at the back of your tongue & gently run the scraper all the way to the front two or three times Rinse the scraper under warm water between scrapes Swish your mouth out with water afterward
